answer: YES: a timestamped visible read projection of actual existing operational failure facts satisfies original J06 without material authority, a new DB, notification framework or trading action.
chosen_minimum: Project already durable FAILED research jobs as recorded operational failures, and render populated rows in existing Health alert panel. Keep process/Paper observations in their existing health/trading views; do not expand J06 into a comprehensive alarm engine.

spec_refs.text: Overview includes alerts/reasons disabled; Health separates component states/timestamps and never infers SAFE_TO_TRADE; deterministic reason text and honest empty/fixture states
Legacy retained except explicit amendments; unspecified risk/provider/canonical lifecycle changes require review. This projection changes none of those authorities.

current_wiring.fact: Actual same-namespace resolver/policies compose ResearchQueue at config.local_data_root/queue.sqlite; queue is None without selected research policies. control_services already injects research_queue=self.queue,registry_factory and paper_reader into OwnerControlServices. No new HTTP-selected factory or driver is necessary.
self.queue already references the actual configured namespace queue. No alerts branch exists; falls through to LocalControlServices.view.
Unconfigured alerts yield items=[],total=None,status=NOT_CONFIGURED,reason OWNER_NOT_CONFIGURED. Preserve this uncommissioned default.

Existing authenticated GET /api/v1/alerts returns ViewEnvelope[PageView]. Limits1..200/offset0..100000; items JsonValue[],total nullable; metadata includes request observation/as_of/freshness/namespace. No new public command route or CSRF exception needed.

Health already fetches /alerts, polls visible page every30seconds with one in-flight request, and has 告警 panel. Existing nonempty content is only collapsed JSON; render a human-visible populated list/table using reasonText/utcDisplay, with raw detail optional.

actual_fact_inventory.semantics: finish_terminated_worker verifies exact OwnedProcess termination and reaped tree before FAILED/OWNED_WORKER_TIMEOUT or other typed failure. FAILED is operational job failure; COMPLETE/BLOCKED/OOS numeric FAIL are different and must not be relabeled broken service. No job delete is permitted by existing trigger.

Do not call evidence_view/ResearchService.report from alert polling; it may traverse more owner artifacts and is unnecessary. Never replay research/OOS or normalize copied outputs to fabricate alerts.

Existing readonly2s SQLite health read returns RECENT_HEARTBEAT/STALE_HEARTBEAT/CONFIG_CHANGED/CLOCK_REGRESSION/PROCESS_NOT_RUNNING/FAILED or typed unknown/storage failure. This is process observation,not financial permission. Existing Health view remains source; no required J06 process-alert aggregation in the minimum slice.

Reader verifies actual current runtime history/generation/config/PID/heartbeat and raises typed unavailable. No launch/generation allocation. Do not call full release/capability/source hashing from alert GET.

Checkpoint can be LAST_KNOWN_OWNER_FACTS/PROCESS_HEALTH_UNKNOWN; canonical mismatch/pending publication are diagnostics,not automatic current broker failure. list traverses each accepted run and view may aggregate closed metrics. Do not poll all Paper runs or expose position/fill/PnL in the minimum alerts slice.

proposed_internal_seams.behavior: One narrow readonly fixed query against actual self.path, same namespace verified. Select only run_id,state,revision,generation,updated_at,reason_codes_json WHERE state=FAILED. Filter before pagination, stable actual primary-key run_id ASC order. Do not use list then filter,which hides failures behind earlier healthy rows. No table/migration/DB creation, no claim/step/cancel/evidence_view or service factory.

alerts branch uses only injected self.queue.failed_alert_page; return NOT_CONFIGURED default when queue None, AVAILABLE empty when actual configured read succeeds with no failures, AVAILABLE rows otherwise. Do not derive alerts from super().view(health) generic OPERATIONAL_OWNERS_NOT_CONFIGURED placeholder.

For application:alerts preserve request observed_at and mark rows explicit historical source facts. Do not assign request time to each event; do not let generic CURRENT metadata imply a healthy/recent worker or current broker state. With source failure use UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN metadata instead of empty AVAILABLE.

Render each actual row visibly with recorded failure,source,UTC/display time and exact reason code plus deterministic Traditional-Chinese explanation; optional raw allowlisted detail. Persistent FIXTURE banner remains. Unknown code gets existing safe fallback. No retry/restart/acknowledge/financial-action button.

alert_shape.alert_id: sha256 canonical hash of namespace,product_instance_id,source_kind,run_id,revision,generation; unchanged poll => unchanged ID
alert_shape.source_ref: research:<validated local run_id>,or its hash if a reference must be hidden
alert_shape.reason_codes: bounded validated canonical reason-code tokens only

privacy_and_semantics: Never select or serialize input_json,outcome_json,actor/owner_id,provider account/order/fill identifiers,raw errors,balances,local paths,credentials or freeform report contents. No projection of entire row dictionary.

Validate UTC,identity/count types and reason token grammar/length before serialization. Invalid persisted data is typed unavailable,never silently skipped into empty success. Reuse existing safe reason conventions; do not interpolate raw exception text.

Do not create an ACTIVE/RESOLVED/ACKNOWLEDGED alert lifecycle or infer current service failure from an old FAILED job. The visible label explicitly says recorded job failure; history can remain visible without automated recovery logic.
Do not alert on statistical rejection,BLOCKED/missing policy or normal pause/stop/NOT_STARTED merely because it is not green. Those existing semantic states remain visible in their own views.
A stable ID is display deduplication only,not permission,qualification evidence,command idempotency or generation issuer.
bounded_read_design: Use existing PageQuery limit1..200 and offset0..100000,validate internally as well. No COUNT(*) required: total=None is truthful. ORDER BY primary-key run_id avoids unindexed global date sorting.

Use mode=ro with query_only and verified existing queue namespace; do not reuse ResearchQueue._db for this GET if it can create a missing DB or set WAL mode. Existing _db uses read-write connection/PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL. Missing/mutated/unreadable store returns typed unavailable without creating replacement.

LIMIT bounds returned rows,not underlying scan work. With WHERE FAILED over unbounded history,add a small fixed cooperative SQLite progress/opcode budget and bounded busy timeout consistent with existing control readers,then return UNAVAILABLE on interruption. Root must measure representative sparse-failure history; do not claim a hard disk-I/O deadline from busy_timeout. No new DB/index/framework is necessary for the bounded slice.

Bound reason JSON before materializing it (fixed byte cap),validate token count/length; do not load job inputs/results. Apply checked bounded row reads rather than silently excluding oversized invalid rows.
Polling/read failures affect the authenticated Control response only. No read lock held while rendering,network or long computation; no alert query or child spawn inside protective worker.tick.

regression_targets.tests: Actual queue failure via existing owner path produces stable ID,original updated_at/revision/generation; healthy/COMPLETE/BLOCKED rows excluded; filter-before-page handles many preceding nonfailures. Namespace mismatch/missing DB/oversize malformed reason data denies without file creation or mutation.

Authenticated configured actual queue failure yields same source fact in GET /alerts; configured empty differs from NOT_CONFIGURED; DB failure is UNAVAILABLE not empty; repeated GET changes no queue rows/commands/leases/owner generations; no private input/outcome/paths/provider identifiers in JSON. Include LOCAL_RESEARCH and FIXTURE composition under actual namespaces.

Populated actual backend failure renders visible reason/time/source/stable reference; old failure clearly historical; no mock HTTP route needed. Real empty/unknown still honest,timezone display does not replace source UTC,unknown code safe fallback,FIXTURE banner persists.

Fixed native evidence stage binds browser alert reference/reason/time to actual native failed job and unchanged original protected owner; partial/failed browser or unreaped tree cannot issue J06 scoped success.

sequence: Use actual existing isolated FIXTURE research timeout/reaped child case; no DB insertion,outcome injection,threshold lowering,private provider or new authority.
Require actual failed job state/reason and confirmed child tree reap. If child completes or no admission,fail truthfully instead of inventing timeout alert.

Authenticated loopback GET /alerts returns exact observed job ref,source revision/generation,original UTC reason and namespace. Render same row in actual installed Health panel; no route mocks,remote browser request or canned screenshot.
Confirm repeated polling preserves original Paper binding/checkpoint/protection identity and advances protection observations where the existing isolation case requires; no alert-triggered action.

Normal namespace LOCAL_RESEARCH behavior is covered by source composition test and,if root selects a normal native diagnostic timeout attempt,its separate exact identity. Do not relabel FIXTURE proof real LIVE/ordinary financial qualification.
native_check.result: NOT_RUN;root implements only after current checkpoint and executes exact final subject later

explicit_non_goals: No comprehensive process/Paper alarm taxonomy or repeated multi-source merge pagination.
No autoaction,notification delivery,ack/silence rules,new financial policy,credentials/provider capability,approval or permission change.
No full source/capability/receipt hashing or native verifier launch in alert GET.
No claim to complete all v0.2 runtime/operational-fault requirements from J06 smoke.
